name: dynamic-island
blurb: Animating container morphs between size presets with spring physics.
description: A motion-based container inspired by Apple's Dynamic Island that smoothly animates between size presets (compact, default, medium, large, ultra, massive, etc.). Spring physics and context-based state management.
use_when: iOS-inspired UIs, status displays, notifications, or floating containers needing morphing effect.
avoid_when: When complex nested layouts are needed; works best with simple content inside the island.
a11y: Spring animations via motion/react; content accessibility depends on children components and DynamicTitle/Description.
